basic_details.job_title: LAHDC SSRB Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 216 Driver, Technician and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Leh Autonomous Hill Development-Subordinate Services Recruitment Board (LAHD-SSRB) has released Advertisement No. 02 of 2026 for 216 district cadre vacancies, including Driver, Technician, Junior Assistant, Junior Nurse, Junior Pharmacist, Work Supervisor and other posts. Online applications start on 27 October 2026 and close on 27 November 2026. Eligible Leh District domicile candidates can apply through the official website.

It is non-refundable and non-transferable. | Candidates applying for more than one category of post must submit the applicable separate applications and fee payments. The application will not be considered if the required fee is not paid.

age_limit.details: The general age limit for LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026 is 18 to 40 years as on 1 January 2026. Candidates must have been born between 1 January 1986 and 1 January 2008, inclusive, for the general age requirement. Relaxation is available to eligible categories. | Age relaxation for reserved categories is governed by the relevant provisions of the notification. Age relaxation against unreserved posts will be restricted to the relaxation available for UR candidates.

qualification.details: Only eligible residents of the erstwhile Leh District can apply for the LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026 district cadre posts. Candidates must possess the prescribed Domicile Certificate issued by the competent authority under the applicable Union Territory of Ladakh rules. | Applicants from outside the prescribed erstwhile Leh District domicile area are not eligible merely because they reside elsewhere in Ladakh. Candidates must verify their domicile status before submitting the online form.

how_to_apply: Visit the official LAHD-SSRB website at lahdssrb.in.
Open the recruitment application link for Advertisement Notice No. 02 of 2026.
Complete the required one-time registration using your active mobile number and email address.
Log in with your registered credentials.
Select the post category for which you meet the eligibility requirements.
Complete the application form with personal, domicile, category and qualification details.
Upload the required photograph, signature and supporting documents according to the portal instructions.
Review the completed application carefully.

content_sections.heading: LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026 online application process begins on 27 October 2026. The last date to submit the application and complete online fee payment is 27 November 2026. The written examination date will be announced separately on the official website.

content_sections.heading: LAHD SSRB Vacancy 2026 - Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: LAHD-SSRB has announced 216 vacancies in matriculation, 10+2 and graduate-level post categories. The vacancies are distributed among departments including Health and Medical Education, Public Works, Rural Development, Revenue, Animal Husbandry and Sheep Husbandry. The recruitment includes vacancies under Unreserved, Scheduled Tribe, Actual Line of Control and Economically Weaker Sections categories. The official annexure also identifies applicable horizontal reservations. Important: The official Annexure XVI reports a total of 216 vacancies, while its printed category-wise totals add up to 197. Candidates should follow any official clarification or corrigendum issued by LAHD-SSRB rather than assuming an allocation for the difference. content_sections.heading: LAHD SSRB Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility for LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026 depends on the selected post. Candidates may require Matriculation (10th pass), 10+2, relevant trade certification, a technical diploma, nursing qualification or a recognized university degree. All candidates must also satisfy the prescribed Leh domicile and age conditions. Note: Candidates must refer to Annexure XVI of the official notification for the complete wording of trade names, qualification requirements, recognized certificates and post-specific conditions. Yes. Candidates who have passed Class 10 may be eligible for posts such as Orderly, Chowkidar, Safaiwala, Attendant and other matriculation-level positions. Technical posts may require additional ITI, trade certificates or driving qualifications. Yes. Candidates with 10+2 qualifications may apply for certain posts, including Veterinary Pharmacist, Stock Assistant and VLW/MPW. Medical and technical positions may require additional specialized diplomas or professional qualifications. Junior Assistant / Ledger Clerk applicants must be graduates from a recognized university and meet the prescribed computer qualification and typing requirements. The notification specifies minimum 200 hours of computer training or a six-month recognized computer applications certificate course and a typing speed of at least 35 words per minute.

content_sections.heading: LAHD SSRB Domicile Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Only eligible residents of the erstwhile Leh District can apply for the LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026 district cadre posts. Candidates must possess the prescribed Domicile Certificate issued by the competent authority under the applicable Union Territory of Ladakh rules. Applicants from outside the prescribed erstwhile Leh District domicile area are not eligible merely because they reside elsewhere in Ladakh. Candidates must verify their domicile status before submitting the online form.

content_sections.heading: LAHD SSRB Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The general age limit for LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026 is 18 to 40 years as on 1 January 2026. Candidates must have been born between 1 January 1986 and 1 January 2008, inclusive, for the general age requirement. Relaxation is available to eligible categories. Age relaxation for reserved categories is governed by the relevant provisions of the notification. Age relaxation against unreserved posts will be restricted to the relaxation available for UR candidates.

rows.maximum_age: As per notified service-deduction and relaxation rules

content_sections.heading: LAHD SSRB Salary 2026 - Post-wise Pay Scale
content_sections.text: The LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026 pay scales range from ₹14,800 to ₹81,100 across different posts and pay levels. Actual basic salary depends on the selected post's level. The notification specifies pay levels rather than a fixed in-hand salary. The Junior Assistant / Ledger Clerk post carries Level 4 pay of ₹25,500 to ₹81,100. The starting basic pay is ₹25,500, while actual in-hand salary depends on applicable allowances and deductions. Driver Grade-II carries Level 2 pay of ₹19,900 to ₹63,200. Actual take-home salary will vary according to applicable service rules and deductions. Junior Nurse carries Level 4 pay of ₹25,500 to ₹81,100. This is the notified pay-matrix range and not a confirmed in-hand salary.

content_sections.heading: LAHD SSRB Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026 selection process includes an objective-type written examination conducted through CBT, TBT or OMR mode, as decided by the Board. Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification. Applicable qualifying skill tests may also be conducted for specific posts. Computer-Based / Tablet-Based / OMR Written Examination Qualifying Skill Test, where prescribed Shortlisting Based on Merit and Vacancies Document Verification Final Selection and Departmental Appointment Procedures The Board has prescribed a minimum qualifying score of 20% in the written examination. Meeting this minimum does not automatically guarantee shortlisting, as additional merit-based criteria may apply.

content_sections.heading: LAHD SSRB Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The LAHD SSRB 2026 written examination will contain 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks. The subjects are General Intelligence, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude and English Language. The examination duration is 90 minutes, with negative marking of 0.25 marks for each incorrect answer. Question Type: Objective Multiple Choice Examination Duration: 1 Hour 30 Minutes Duration for Eligible Scribe Candidates: 2 Hours Negative Marking: 0.25 marks for each wrong answer Examination Medium: English Minimum Qualifying Marks: 20%

content_sections.heading: LAHD SSRB Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The syllabus covers General Intelligence, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude and English Language. The difficulty level will correspond to the prescribed qualification level of the post, including Matriculation, 10+2 and Graduation. Analogy, similarity and differences, problem solving, analysis, judgment, decision-making, visual memory, discrimination, observation, relationships, number series, non-verbal reasoning and related topics. Current affairs, everyday science, history, geography, culture, economics, general polity, scientific research and matters relating to India and neighbouring countries. Number systems, whole numbers, decimals, fractions, percentages, ratio and proportion, averages, interest, profit and loss, discount, time and distance, time and work, algebra, geometry, mensuration and data interpretation. Topics vary according to examination level. Vocabulary, grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms, correct usage, comprehension and other prescribed English-language topics.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: LAHD-SSRB has announced 216 district cadre vacancies under Advertisement No. 02 of 2026 for various matriculation, 10+2 and graduate-level positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online and pay the application fee is 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When will LAHD SSRB online applications start?
faq.answer: Online applications for Advertisement No. 02 of 2026 will begin on 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The prescribed application fee is ₹200, payable through the official online application portal. The fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The general age limit is 18 to 40 years as on 1 January 2026. Eligible reserved-category applicants may receive age relaxation under the notified rules.

faq.question: Q6. Can candidates from outside Leh District apply?
faq.answer: No. The notification requires candidates to hold the prescribed domicile status for the erstwhile Leh District and satisfy the district cadre eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q7. Can 10th-pass candidates apply for LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Several matriculation-level vacancies are open to eligible 10th-pass candidates. Some posts require additional ITI, technical training or driving qualifications.

faq.question: Q8. Can 12th-pass candidates apply for LAHD SSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Certain vacancies require 10+2 qualifications, while technical or medical positions may also require specialized diplomas or training.

faq.question: Q9. How many Junior Assistant vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The notification lists 15 vacancies for Junior Assistant / Junior Assistant-Ledger Clerk posts.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary of an LAHD SSRB Junior Assistant?
faq.answer: Junior Assistant posts carry Level 4 pay of ₹25,500 to ₹81,100. Actual in-hand salary depends on allowances and deductions.
